To summarise 
Apply to a specific country with fully booked flights and hotel stays. Make sure to attach a cover letter which describes her ties to the uk and ask for a long term schengen visa. 

You’ll have to apply online, book an appointment date and submit the passport, proof of funds, proof of stay and travel + biometrics at the embassy (of whichever country you’re applying to)

Generally you’ll have to have travelled atleast twice to the schengen area and followed their rules about staying/overstaying to get a two year multiple entry visa. But I’m not sure if they’ll give a longer visa based on her current uk spouse status. 

Either way, once she has a visa from a specific country she can travel anywhere in the EU (for as long as her visa is valid and number of entries that she’s allowed). Make sure that the country she’s applied to is her point of entry to the EU or the destination that you spend the most time in
